summary: - **[key4hep/k4geo#669](https://github.com/key4hep/k4geo/pull/669)** — Adds the first version of the ALFA detector concept for FCC-ee (`ALFA_o1_v00`). It includes a Grainita ECAL barrel driver (`Grainita_ECAL_Barrel_v02`) with a dedicated SD action, an outer tracker barrel, a new `FCCSWGridRhoPhiTheta_k4geo` segmentation, and an example steering file. The shared `VertexBarrel_detailed_o1_v03` constructor is modified as part of this PR.

- **[key4hep/k4FWCore#413](https://github.com/key4hep/k4FWCore/pull/413)** — `OverlayTiming` gains a `RandomMixBackgroundFiles` option for beam-induced background produced as many single-event files. Each file in a group becomes an independent event source, drawn from a shuffled permutation that is reshuffled once exhausted, so a run no longer overlays only the first few files of a group. Documentation and dedicated tests are included.

- **[HEP-FCC/FCC-config#402](https://github.com/HEP-FCC/FCC-config/pull/402)** — ALLEGRO digi/reco steering gains a `siDigitizer` option to select the new `VTXdigitizerDetailed` silicon digitiser instead of DDPlanarDigi. Pixel pitches are now parsed from the compact files as the single source of truth, while effective DDPlanarDigi resolutions remain overridable. Thresholds and smearing for the detailed digitiser still need to be tuned.

- **[PandoraPFAOrg/LCContent#33](https://github.com/PandoraPFAOrg/LCContent/pull/33)** — Adds Pandora particle-flow algorithms for the IDEA option-2 detector, including ECAL-seeded HCAL clustering, a dual-readout correction plugin, forward photon ID and IDEA PFO creation. ONNX-based photon ID and satellite-cluster merging are built only when `LCContent_BUILD_ML=ON`. Requires PandoraSDK ≥ 04.00.01, and the new algorithms are not auto-registered in `LCContent::RegisterAlgorithms`, so client applications must register them.

- **[key4hep/k4ActsTracking#124](https://github.com/key4hep/k4ActsTracking/pull/124)** — Fixes the hit covariance in `prepareTrackerHits`, which assigned `du`/`dv` directly to the surface local axes without rotating them. Where these axes are swapped (e.g. MAIA tracker endcaps), the precise and coarse uncertainties were exchanged, causing good forward hits to fail the CKF χ² cut. Barrel results are unchanged.

- **[key4hep/k4ActsTracking#125](https://github.com/key4hep/k4ActsTracking/pull/125)** — Adds an `InitialTrackError_QOverP` property to `CKFTrackingAlg` and `GNNTrackFinder`. It is an absolute q/p error added in quadrature to the purely relative one, which lets the CKF correct poorly estimated momenta of high-pT seeds without loosening soft seeds.

- **[key4hep/k4RecTracker#113](https://github.com/key4hep/k4RecTracker/pull/113)** — `TrackMerger` adds track-parameter significance as a matching criterion and makes it the default. Matching defaults are aligned with `ClonesAndSplitTracksFinder` in CLDConfig, so merger output changes for existing configurations.

- **[key4hep/k4RecTracker#117](https://github.com/key4hep/k4RecTracker/pull/117)** — `VTXdigitizerDetailed` now reads the sensor thickness from the sensitive volume rather than from the ZPlanarData/ZPetalData extensions. This enables the digitiser for compound vertex detectors such as ALLEGRO, and CLD output is verified unchanged.

- **[key4hep/k4RecTracker#116](https://github.com/key4hep/k4RecTracker/pull/116)** — `GGTFTrackFinder` gains an `EmbeddingCoordinates` property so it can run models trained with different embedding-space dimensions. Extra model output features are tolerated and ignored instead of crashing inference.

- **[key4hep/k4Gen#62](https://github.com/key4hep/k4Gen/pull/62)** — `HepMCToEDMConverter` now preserves particle order and includes vertex time. With this change, ddsim hit collections match between HepMC3 and EDM4hep inputs.

- **[key4hep/k4Bench#241](https://github.com/key4hep/k4Bench/pull/241)** — Nightly reconstruction benchmarks now cover ALLEGRO o1_v04/o2_v01, CLD o3_v01, IDEA o1_v04/o2_v01 and ILD_FCCee v01/v02 on Zbb and single-electron samples. Support for fetching external data files into benchmark jobs is added alongside.

- **[key4hep/k4Bench#245](https://github.com/key4hep/k4Bench/pull/245)** — k4run benchmarks gain an untimed memory pass that attributes every heap allocation to its owning Gaudi component and records per-event heap snapshots. This enables per-component memory and leak tracking for reconstruction jobs.
